result.topic_en: A heavily corrected prose draft on geodesy: discrepancies between geodetic and astronomical latitude differences in the Hanoverian arc measurement (Göttingen–Altona), attributed to local deflections of the plumb line, and a proposal to determine these deflections by comparative pendulum observations linked by electric telegraph, after Airy.
